content: Monitoring of laboratory tests, such as kidney function and amikacin blood levels, may be necessary while you are using this medication. It is essential to attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. If you miss a dose of this medication, it is crucial to contact your doctor or pharmacist immediately to establish a new dosing schedule. For proper storage of this medication, refer to the product instructions or consult your pharmacist. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. When the medication is expired or no longer needed, discard it appropriately. Please note that the information provided here is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your specific condition. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this medication and your individual health needs. Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this medication with other drugs in the same class. To view formulary information, you must first create a list of plans. This list can be saved and edited at any time. Keep in mind that individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, contact the applicable plan provider.
